domain: IPN (Insurance Product Notation): a declarative language for defining insurance products, with a reference engine, the Python 3.12 standard-library-only package ipngine. Tests run with python3 -m unittest. The audience is insurance professionals, so the language reads like English.

steps.name: reproduce
steps.prompt: Write a failing test that captures the issue, and commit it. Do not fix the issue in this step.

steps.name: fix
steps.prompt: Make the failing test pass with the smallest good change, and tidy the code you touch. Keep docs/reference/ in step with any language change. All arithmetic is Decimal, never float.

agent.append: Follow CLAUDE.md. Use British English. Make small atomic commits: a one-line summary of what changed, then a paragraph on why.
